items.headline: SpaceXAI releases Grok 4.7
items.summary: Grok 4.7 is the company's most capable model for coding and knowledge work, priced the same as Grok 4.6 and available in Cursor, Grok Build, the API and third-party platforms. The company reports gains over Grok 4.6 on benchmarks including Terminal-Bench 4.0 (37.6%) and DeepSWE v1.1 (71.0%).
